events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's enduring legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost one of music's most electrifying performers. Freddie Mercury's legacy with Queen continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Iconic album release
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the tragic passing of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating the Starman
angles.copy: David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years ago, a legend was born. Elvis Presley's impact on music and pop culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar god's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin redefined rock music forever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Rod the Mod
angles.copy: The one and only Rod Stewart turns 82 today! What's your favourite hit from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman's big day
angles.copy: The inimitable Suggs from Madness is 66 today! Always bringing the house of fun.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, born in 1956, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful voice of the 80s
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth vocals of Paul Young! Still love those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating the Queen of Country
angles.copy: The one and only Dolly Parton is 81 today! A true legend who has given us so many timeless songs.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's head songwriter
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a songwriting powerhouse.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a smooth voice
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean! His voice defined an era.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock history made
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was officially cemented with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be your first pick for induction?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Iconic rooftop gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: A true musical powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A drumming legend and a voice that defined the 80s.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo stardom, he truly does it all.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940, famous for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National treasure's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable Sir David Jason! A true national treasure.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Remembering a tragic loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, rock and roll lost three stars too soon. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, born in 1966, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never gonna give him up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still rocking stages and never gonna give us up. What's your favourite Rickroll moment?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to resonate across the globe.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: A songwriting genius
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs have soundtracked generations.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice remembered
angles.copy: Fifteen years ago, the music world lost 'The Voice'. Remembering Whitney Houston and her incredible talent today.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their first split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: The day hearts broke
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago, the news broke: Take That were splitting up. A moment etched in pop history. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Voice of UB40
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40! Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Global superstar's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! A songwriting maestro and global sensation.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, born in 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering the quiet Beatle
angles.copy: George Harrison would have turned 84 today. His spiritual influence and incredible songwriting left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman, Roger Daltrey! Still smashing it.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, born in 1958, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: 80s pop icon's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to Nik Kershaw! An 80s pop icon with a timeless sound.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin, born in 1977, celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Coldplay's milestone birthday
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century of incredible music and anthems.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi, born in 1962, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Still living on a prayer and rocking the world.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Chris Rea, born in 1951, known for hits like 'Driving Home for Christmas', would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a unique voice
angles.copy: Chris Rea would have been 76 today. His bluesy rock sound and storytelling continue to captivate.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The late Mary Wilson of The Supremes, born in 1943, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Supreme talent
angles.copy: Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have been 83 today. Her elegance and talent helped define the Motown sound.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson first performed the iconic Moonwalk during his performance of 'Billie Jean' at Motown 25.

angles.name: Moonwalk takes flight
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago, Michael Jackson unveiled the Moonwalk to the world. A moment that changed dance and pop culture forever.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan, born in 1958, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Synth-pop pioneer's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the influential Gary Numan! His unique sound paved the way for so much electronic music.
